claim.quote: The difference between the reactor-on and reactor-off spectra shows no excess at low energies and yields upper limits at 95% confidence level for the neutrino interaction rates.

key_value_text.quote: In the lowest-energy range, 50-180 eV, the expected limit stands at 34 (39) times the standard model prediction, while the observed limit is 66 (75) times the standard model prediction with Sarkis (Chavarria) quenching factors.
key_value_text.value: Observed limit 66 (75) times the Standard Model prediction in 50-180 eV (Sarkis/Chavarria quenching), 95% CL

name: Search for coherent elastic neutrino-nucleus scattering at a nuclear reactor with CONNIE 2019 data

significance.quote: yields upper limits at 95% confidence level for the neutrino interaction rates

summary.plain: With a silicon CCD array operated 30 metres from a reactor core and a detection threshold of 50 electronvolts, CONNIE saw no excess when the reactor was on. It set upper limits on the rate of neutrino-nucleus scattering of about 66 times the Standard Model prediction at the lowest energies.
summary.technical: 2019 data, 8 CCDs, 36.2 g fiducial mass, 2.2 kg-days: reactor-on minus reactor-off spectra show no low-energy excess; in 50-180 eV the expected limit is 34 (39) and the observed limit 66 (75) times the SM prediction for Sarkis (Chavarria) quenching.

title: Search for coherent elastic neutrino-nucleus scattering at a nuclear reactor with CONNIE 2019 data
why_it_matters: The most sensitive reactor CEvNS limits in the sub-keV range of the time, a step towards observing CEvNS at reactors.
